premises.text: After-school private tutoring is essential for success, but many students struggle for hours to find a qualified, accessible, available tutor
premises.evidence_span: One out of three students struggle to find a tutor

premises.text: A peer-to-peer app lets students pick a course, choose a pre-vetted tutor, book in-person or online sessions with chat, materials, and built-in tutoring tools
premises.evidence_span: a peer-to-peer platform that connects students to highly qualified private tutors in three simple steps

premises.text: Tutor hiring is automated with ML pre-selection, and matching uses algorithms and a graph database for personalized real-time recommendations
premises.evidence_span: Our machine learning algorithm are helping our HR team to pre-select our candidates

premises.text: Unlike inflexible centers and online platforms, Syncios matches peer tutors with shared educational background and rewards tutors with hours-based pay, internships, training, and bonuses
premises.evidence_span: we match students with peer tutors who have been in their shoes and have the same educational background

premises.text: MENA Arabic go-to-market with school/university partnerships; monetization is 20% tutor commission plus institutional analytics subscriptions
premises.evidence_span: We charge our tutors a 20% commission per transaction

value.text: Education becomes accessible through a self-regulated knowledge-exchange tutoring community
